events.summary: Southwest Airlines announced plans to open its first airport lounges in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu, and Nashville by late 2027, partnering with Chase. Access to these lounges will be available through a new premium Southwest Rapid Rewards credit card expected to launch in 2027. This move is part of Southwest's broader strategy to adapt its business model, which recently included eliminating open seating and introducing baggage fees, to attract and retain higher-spending customers.

events.title: Man Group plc Purchases Shares of 20,715 SouthState Bank Corporation $SSB
events.summary: Man Group plc acquired 20,715 shares of SouthState Bank Corporation (NYSE:SSB) during the second quarter, valued at approximately $2.07 million. SouthState Bank also beat earnings expectations and increased its quarterly dividend, despite some insider selling.

events.title: TD Cowen Downgrades EyePoint Pharmaceuticals to Hold From Buy, Adjusts PT to $4 From $20
events.summary: TD Cowen has downgraded EyePoint Pharmaceuticals from "Buy" to "Hold" and significantly reduced its price target from $20 to $4. This downgrade follows EyePoint's recent announcement of missing the primary goal in its Phase 3 wet age-related macular degeneration trial for DURAVYU, leading to regulatory uncertainty and multiple analyst downgrades.

events.title: Earnings Flash (DAKT) Daktronics, Inc. Reports Q1 Revenue $234.6M, vs. FactSet Est of $230.3M
events.summary: Daktronics, Inc. (DAKT) announced its Q1 revenue reached $234.6 million, surpassing FactSet's estimate of $230.3 million. This positive financial update indicates stronger-than-expected performance for the company in the first quarter.

events.title: Oncology company Thyme Care raises $125M, backed by Morgan Health, Humana and CVS Health Ventures
events.summary: Thyme Care has raised over $125 million in a Series E funding round, led by JPMorgan's Morgan Health and including participation from Humana and CVS Health Ventures, pushing its valuation past $2 billion. The funding will support the company's growth beyond cancer care navigation and establish Thyme Companies, a new parent organization focused on addressing broader cancer care challenges. Thyme Care aims to improve patient care and reduce costs, and the newly formed Thyme Companies plans to launch new businesses, including initiatives to accelerate biosimilar adoption and improve clinical trial accrual.

events.title: Influential Women Features Cathleen Ryan Reneer: Managing Director At JPMorgan Chase & Co.
events.summary: Cathleen Ryan Reneer, Managing Director at JPMorgan Chase & Co., is featured by Influential Women for her over four decades of leadership in cybersecurity and identity management. Reneer, a dynamic and results-driven leader, oversees Global Identity and Access Management operations, leveraging extensive experience from her 30-year tenure at IBM. She is also dedicated to mentoring and advancing women in technology, advocating for risk-taking and continuous learning in the field.

events.title: NIO (NYSE:NIO) Downgraded to "Neutral" Rating by JPMorgan Chase & Co.
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. downgraded NIO (NYSE:NIO) from an "overweight" to a "neutral" rating, setting a $4.50 price target. This downgrade comes as NIO's stock opened lower, trading near its 12-month low, despite reporting $4.73 billion in quarterly revenue, but remaining unprofitable. Analyst consensus on NIO is currently a "Hold" with an average price target of $6.38.

events.title: Daktronics (NASDAQ:DAKT) Shares Gap Up After Strong Earnings
events.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ:DAKT) shares gapped up after reporting strong fiscal Q1 earnings, with EPS of $0.40 exceeding estimates and revenue rising 7.1% year-over-year to $234.6 million. The company showed improved gross margin, strong operating cash flow, and a significant cash balance against minimal debt. Despite a decline in new orders and backlog compared to the previous year, analysts maintain a "Hold" rating with a $29 price target.

events.title: Analog Devices to Participate in the J.P. Morgan U.S. All Stars Conference
events.summary: Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Richard Puccio, will attend the J.P. Morgan U.S. All Stars Conference in London on September 22. He will discuss business topics and trends, and the event will be webcast live with an archived replay available on the company's Investor Relations website.

events.title: Southwest Airlines' First-Ever Lounges to Debut in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu, and Nashville; with at Least Seven More Planned
events.summary: Southwest Airlines announced plans for its first-ever airport lounge network, partnering with Chase to create a premium experience. The initial four lounges are expected to open in late 2027 in Austin, Baltimore, Honolulu, and Nashville, with at least seven more planned. Access to these lounges will be available through a new premium Southwest Rapid Rewards Credit Card launching in 2027.

events.title: Morgan Stanley downgrades Smith & Nephew stock rating on guidance concerns
events.summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Smith & Nephew (NYSE: SNN) to Equalweight from Overweight and lowered its price target due to concerns over the company's ambitious medium-term guidance and challenged growth in key segments. Although the stock may be undervalued per InvestingPro data, Morgan Stanley believes a rebasement of guidance is necessary. This follows recent earnings misses and similar downgrades from JPMorgan and BTIG.

events.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Raised Buybacks And Its Dividend, Is The Stock Fully Priced?
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) has recently increased its share repurchase program and quarterly dividend, alongside positive developments in its payments and capital markets businesses. The stock has seen strong positive momentum, with a 17.98% return over 90 days and a 20.70% total shareholder return over one year. While a popular valuation narrative suggests the stock is undervalued at around $373.86, risks such as fintech competition and regulatory costs could impact future performance.

events.title: Legal & General Group Plc Purchases New Holdings in Allison Transmission Holdings, Inc. $ALSN
events.summary: Legal & General Group Plc has acquired a new stake of 77,777 shares in Allison Transmission Holdings, Inc. valued at approximately $8.8 million during the second quarter. events.title: Manulife Financial Corporation Prices U.S. Public Offering of Subordinated Notes
events.summary: Manulife Financial Corporation has priced a U.S. public offering of $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 6.146% subordinated notes due 2041. These notes are expected to qualify as Tier 2 regulatory capital and will bear interest at a fixed annual rate until September 11, 2036, then at a variable rate plus a spread. The company plans to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, including future refinancing.

events.title: Waymo seeks more than $3B in first debt deal to fund growth
events.summary: Waymo is seeking over $3 billion in its first debt financing deal, with lenders including Pimco, Blackstone, and Sixth Street Partners. This move aims to diversify Waymo's funding beyond equity markets to support its expansion efforts, which include increasing its fleet and managing rising AI costs. The company plans to finalize this unrated loan soon as it targets 1 million paid weekly rides globally this year.

events.title: BlackRock Inc. Purchases Shares of 1,624,752 Tejon Ranch Co $TRC
events.summary: BlackRock Inc. has acquired a new position in Tejon Ranch Co (NYSE:TRC), purchasing 1,624,752 shares valued at approximately $30.4 million, giving it a 6.02% stake. This makes BlackRock part of the 60.63% institutional ownership of the real estate and agribusiness company. events.title: Southwest makes it official: We're opening lounges in these airports
events.summary: Southwest Airlines has officially announced its plans to open its first-ever airport lounge network, marking a significant expansion of its loyalty strategy. This move, which comes after months of speculation, coincides with the launch of a new Chase credit card, indicating a focus on premium travel perks. The article promises details on the locations of these new lounges.

events.title: Itaú Unibanco Gains as Investors Weigh Strong Results, Capital Return, and Brazil Tailwinds
events.summary: Itaú Unibanco (ITUB) shares rose 5.0% due to strong quarterly results, firm credit quality, and ongoing capital returns to shareholders. The bank reported BRL 12.4 billion in recurring managerial net income and an annualized ROE of 24.3% for Q2 2026. Additionally, the approval of BRL 3.99 billion in interest on capital and a repurchase program, combined with Brazil's lower Selic rate, contribute to positive investor sentiment for the financial sector.

events.title: Democratic US senator asks Capital One for details on Trump account anti-money laundering review By Reuters
events.summary: A Democratic U.S. senator, Maggie Hassan, has requested details from Capital One regarding its internal anti-money laundering review that led to the closure of accounts linked to former President Donald Trump and his businesses. This request follows a lawsuit by the Trump Organization alleging the closures were politically motivated, which Capital One denies, stating they were due to standard AML policies. Hassan's inquiry aims to shed light on the bank's reasoning and the broader issue of "debanking."

events.title: State Street to Speak at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference
events.summary: State Street Corporation announced that its CFO, John Woods, will present at the Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference on September 14, 2026, at 11:15 am ET. An audio webcast and replay of the presentation will be available on State Street's Investor Relations website. State Street is a leading financial services provider with $57.9 trillion in assets under custody and $6.3 trillion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026.

events.title: What Financial Services Does Mizuho Financial Group (NYSE:MFG) Actually Provide?
events.summary: Mizuho Financial Group (NYSE:MFG) is a major Japanese banking and financial services holding company offering a broad range of services. Its core businesses include deposit-taking, lending, transaction banking, and treasury services, while also extending into capital markets, underwriting, and asset management. This diversified model allows Mizuho to serve both individual and institutional clients across various financial needs, positioning it as a significant global banking institution.

events.title: Democratic US senator asks Capital One for details on Trump account anti-money laundering review
events.summary: Senator Maggie Hassan has requested Capital One provide details regarding its internal anti-money laundering review that led to the closure of accounts linked to former President Donald Trump and his businesses. events.summary: Corient Private Wealth LP recently acquired 45,177 shares of Western Alliance Bancorporation, valued at approximately $2.9 million, bringing institutional ownership to 79.15%. events.summary: This article compares Wells Fargo, Bank of America, and Citigroup as value alternatives to JPMorgan. events.title: Petroleo Brasileiro S.A.- Petrobras (NYSE:PBR) Upgraded to "Hold" at Zacks Research
events.summary: Zacks Research has upgraded Petroleo Brasileiro S.A.- Petrobras (NYSE:PBR) from a "strong sell" to a "hold" rating. Despite this, the broader analyst consensus for Petrobras remains a "Moderate Buy," with several firms maintaining positive ratings and some increasing price targets. Hedge funds have also been observed to be increasing their positions in the company.

events.title: Goldman Sachs warns investors to expect lower returns over the next year
events.summary: Goldman Sachs' chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer warns investors to expect lower returns for stocks over the next 12 months, in the mid-to-high single-digit percentage range. This comes after a period of phenomenal returns, with the S&P 500 gaining 12% year-to-date in 2026. Oppenheimer attributes this outlook to factors such as a global government bond sell-off and surging crude oil prices, which are pushing yields higher and pressuring stocks.

events.title: Investors Purchase High Volume of Call Options on Cheniere Energy (NYSE:LNG)
events.summary: Investors showed unusually high interest in call options for Cheniere Energy (NYSE:LNG), with trading volume significantly exceeding typical levels. events.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has increased its price target for Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) to $154.00 from $150.00, reiterating an "overweight" rating and suggesting a 15.66% upside. events.title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Cuts Edison International (NYSE:EIX) Price Target to $61.00
events.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. has lowered its price target for Edison International (NYSE:EIX) to $61.00 from $82.00, while maintaining a "neutral" rating. events.summary: Southwest Airlines is set to launch its first airport lounge network in late 2027, nearly six decades after its founding. events.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Targets 2027 Launch For A USD Stablecoin
events.summary: Goldman Sachs and 21 other global banks plan to launch a regulated, USD-backed stablecoin by 2027. This initiative aims to facilitate cross-border payments, institutional settlements, and broader digital asset market activities, with potential expansion to other fiat currencies. For Goldman Sachs, the stablecoin represents an extension of its existing strengths in finance and a strategy to share development costs and regulatory work within the consortium.
